attempts.summary: Built a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL7 nodes had only mariadb-libs, no server), populated appdb.orders with 4 committed rows, took the cluster fully down for a maintenance window, correctly cold-restarted it (bootstrapping from the most-advanced node per grastate.dat), rejoined all members, and verified all data and 3-way membership recovered. Also completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on all three nodes, confirming boot identity changes and full cluster/data recovery after each while preserving quorum.
